description: Detect prompt injection and jailbreak attempts in untrusted text such as scraped web pages, emails and tool output. JSON body {text} (max 50,000 chars) or a batch {texts} or {items} (max 20). Optional source_type, sanitize and include_pii. Returns verdict safe, suspicious or malicious, severity, a 0-100 score and matched spans. Text is not stored. Price $0.005 USDC per call via x402. Example output: {"verdict":"safe","score":0,"chars":56,"severity":"none","categories":{},"matches":[]}

include_pii.description: Optional. If true, also return PII counts and types, never values

items.description: Batch of {id, text, source_type} items, instead of text

sanitize.description: Optional. If true, also return sanitized text

texts.description: Batch of texts, max 20, instead of text

name: prompt_injection_check
